purpose: Catalog of executable runtime design systems for new App installations. Read only the selected runtime usage and component APIs.

systems.installationGuidance: Before create_app_base, read componentSelection once and pass exact exports for the current capability in components. Dependencies and Shell internals are automatic. The selection determines both installation roots and returned API guides; ordinary business implementation should not omit components.
systems.name: Yuanli Design System
systems.summary: High-density enterprise console. Includes a modular Vue runtime with forms, searchable single/multiple selects, data display, overlays and a workspace Shell. Supports selective installation and managed updates; undocumented variants remain references.
signatureTraits: chart headers with time and inspection controls
